title: hieracium pilosella subsp. cingulatum
intro: Hieracium pilosella subsp. cingulatum, commonly known as a type of hawkweed, is a plant species that belongs to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect the body against free radicals. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium pilosella subsp. cingulatum include its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce fever, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, making it useful for treating various infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
